title: Prints Variable
prompt:
Declare a variable and assign it a value, then print out the value.
Sample Input: Hello, World
Sample Output: Hello, World
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's an example in Python, a popular and beginner-friendly programming language:

```python
# Declare a variable and assign it a value
greeting = "Hello, World"

# Print out the value of the variable
print(greeting)
```

When you run this code, it will output:

```
Hello, World
```

This demonstrates how to declare a variable (in this case, `greeting`), assign it a value (in this case, `"Hello, World"`) using string interpolation, and then print out the value of the variable.
